{{Top|leg}}
A '''flatstender''' was a [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] whose job was to travel about the vast expanse of [[Tract of Makem Te|the Tract]] in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], tending to pilgrims in peril, maintaining the stone [[stela]]e that made up the giant funerary monument, removing dead animals, and reporting intruders.<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> Thousands of such individuals were employed by the [[Tract Conviction]] on the planet [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. [[Burba]] of Strekk was a flatstender.<ref name="GATORW" />
